architecture.recommendedModel: Overview Map -> selectable sector -> visitable authored location scene -> event/receipt view -> return to map/town
architecture.overviewAuthority: existing server-owned Expedition Map read model
architecture.visualLayer: asset-pack-backed local props and actors with visualOnly true
architecture.receipts: scene inspection links to scout receipts, event packets, site plans, outpost records, and future approved receipts

serverOwnedSectorLinkage.hiddenCells: no visitable scene truth for hinted or locked_unknown

requirementsBeforeEnable: human approval policy for irreversible or agent actions

editorPreviewApprovalFlow: draft descriptor and asset pack in editor
future mutation gates enabled only after explicit implementation

sceneBasedPros: better fit for GPT Image 2-quality authored/generated art packs
matches existing read-model and visual-only projection patterns
prevents hidden-truth leakage by gating visitable scenes on visible server cells
supports future in-game editor preview without making the editor authority
sceneBasedCons: less seamless than a single continuous world
global route continuity remains receipt/read-model based
continuousWorldRisks: harder to review generated packs as modular data
tradeoffDecision.recommendation: Use scene-based visits for HQ13 and defer any continuous-world ambition until server authority, content streaming, and mutation gates are mature.
